payload.description:
Adjudicate the 247 Proposed data-item findings from pinned source + `patterns/personal-data-concept-map.yaml`.

Disposition per row: accept, reject, or leave unresolved. Do not use scanner output as gold. Do not rewrite labels to match the scanner.

Output: adjudication ledger + packet for human accept. Finding issues stay Proposed until the packet is accepted; then `--apply` and board statuses follow YAML (accepted / rejected / proposed).

Out of scope: scanner changes, data-flow rows (273, later slice), new repositories.
payload.title: Adjudicate remaining proposed data-item findings
